source: Verified Precision Oncology Clinical Trial Registry (ClinicalTrials.gov Data Snapshot)

trials.trial_name: SAVANNAH: Savolitinib + Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant, MET-Amplified NSCLC Following Prior Osimertinib
trials.target_biomarker: EGFR L858R / Ex19del with secondary MET / ctDNA resistance surge
trials.priority_rules: Patients with documented rapid progression and >= 4 rising ctDNA readings receive immediate slot allocation over indolent/stable patients.

trials.trial_name: CodeBreaK 100: Sotorasib (AMG 510) in Advanced Solid Tumors With KRAS p.G12C Mutation
trials.priority_rules: Cohort enrollment capped. When slots are 0, reroute patients to standard-of-care systemic combination therapy.

trials.trial_name: KRYSTAL-12: Adagrasib vs Docetaxel in Previously Treated KRAS G12C Advanced NSCLC
trials.priority_rules: Requires prior systemic therapy failure without active intracranial edema.

trials.trial_name: OlympiAD Extension: Olaparib Monotherapy in Germline BRCA-Mutated HER2-Negative Metastatic Breast Cancer
trials.priority_rules: Prior anthracycline and taxane required unless clinically contraindicated.
